diagnostic.scope: Eight existing pilot cases; fixed affine-map diagnostic only
diagnostic.variance_scope: Same-pilot empirical scores; not independent calibration
diagnostic.result_scope: Conditional-mean and empirical-range diagnostic; no finite-sample coverage, power, recovery or universal bias certification

direct_score_audit.scope: Independent direct per-event score replay of case 6; same pilot, no calibration claim

mean_gap_audit.scope: Post-result root-cause comparison against saved nonlinear continuum fit; no new fits or samples and no re-scoring
